instruction: Search the NFL website for the 2017 Super Bowl score record.

metadata.explanation: Task variation asking to find 2017 Super Bowl scores instead of 2019. Uses the same NFL website navigation pattern with URL verification. The evaluator checks if the active tab URL matches the expected 2017 Super Bowl scores page. Uses existing getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' and metric 'is_expected_active_tab' - no custom functions needed.
metadata.similarity_to_original: Very similar - only changes the year from 2019 to 2017, maintaining same complexity and navigation pattern

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' (chrome.py:710-778) appropriately extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric 'is_expected_active_tab' (chrome.py:18-38) correctly compares actual URL vs expected URL using compare_urls
Expected URL 'https://www.nfl.com/scores/2017/post4' semantically matches instruction (post4 = postseason week 4 = Super Bowl)
Complete coverage: instruction asks to find 2017 Super Bowl scores, evaluator verifies user navigated to correct page
No state timing issues: URL verification works reliably after task completion, no postconfig needed
Data flow is correct: accessibility tree → URL extraction → URL comparison → pass/fail result
